judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`) and a standalone failing acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/onError-non-error-rejection.acceptance.test.ts`), without making any implementation changes to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the production code is untouched, all three new non-Error rejection tests will fail. Additionally, the test file introduces ESLint violations (`unused-vars` for `SendMessageParams` and `require-yield` on `sendMessage`) which breaks `npm run eslint`. Finally, the candidate explicitly declared the required updates to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` out of scope and omitted them.
